For Cats

Yes — we groom cats, too

Plenty of salons turn cats away. Dalila's welcomes them: patient, unhurried baths and de-shedding for short and long coats, with nail clipping, ear cleaning, and a sanitary clip included in every cat bath.

Grooming doesn't have to be your pet's least favorite day. Our stylists work at your cat's pace, so the visit stays calm from drop-off to pickup.
